title: Writing Lesson 1: Describing People and Personalities
topic: Describe a person who has had a significant influence on your life. Explain why this person is important to you.
grammar_structure: Present Perfect Tense (e.g., 'has been', 'has taught me') and Adjectives of Personality (e.g., 'compassionate', 'determined').

difficult_vocabulary.definition: The capacity to have an effect on the character or behavior of someone.
Feeling or showing sympathy and concern for others.

model_answer: A person who has had a significant influence on my life is my grandfather. He has always been a very compassionate and determined individual. Throughout my childhood, he taught me the value of hard work and perseverance. Whenever I faced difficulties, he was there to guide me. His influence has been profound because he showed me by example how to remain calm under pressure and treat everyone with respect.
explanation: This answer scores well because it directly addresses the prompt, uses appropriate vocabulary (significant, compassionate, profound), and demonstrates good command of the Present Perfect tense ('has had', 'has always been'). The ideas flow logically with clear examples.
